note: Governed strategy hypotheses (merit of acquisition / capex / capital allocation). Agent A does NOT draw leverage or debt-service conclusions.

findings.claim: Disciplined bolt-on M&A: acquisitions are small relative to operating cash flow and integrated without material impairments.
findings.credit_mechanism: Consistent, low-risk integration reduces event risk from the acquisition programme.

findings.claim: Capex programme targets organic capacity growth (beds, facilities, technology) consistent with stated strategic priorities.
findings.credit_mechanism: Capacity investment supports durable revenue generation.

findings.claim: Management emphasises shareholder returns (buybacks) alongside growth; sustained large distributions warrant monitoring.
findings.credit_mechanism: Aggressive distribution appetite can compete with reinvestment and balance-sheet strength over time.
